# Workforce Next - Complete Reference

> Workforce Next Pvt. Ltd. is an IT consulting and IT services company based in India. It offers remote developers and QA engineers for startups to enterprises on dedicated, fractional, or full-time engagements with flexible hours and flexible timezone coverage. Engineers plug straight into customer engineering, product, and consulting functions and ship software for the customer. People are matched by industry context and longevity signals using SethAI, an AI-powered recruiter. Engineers can work standard India hours or shift their schedule to overlap with US, UK, EU, Canada, Australia, or Dubai working hours. Founded in 2020. Headquartered in DLF Cyber City, Gurugram, Haryana, India. Tech office at NPX Urbtech, Sector 153, Noida, U.P., India.

---

## Company Overview

Workforce Next started as a software services company and saw the same problem everywhere: offshore teams that reset context every few months. Developers would leave, new ones would join, and clients would spend weeks re-explaining their product, their architecture, and their business decisions. The company pivoted to focus exclusively on building dedicated engineering teams that stay.

The core insight: a developer who has worked on your product for 12 months is worth three times a new developer of equal skill, because of context, not code. Everything Workforce Next does is designed to make teams last longer and make accumulated context visible and protected.

Website: https://workforcenext.in
Email: hello@workforcenext.in
Phone: +91-9582595166
LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/workforce-next

---

## SethAI - AI Recruiter

SethAI is Workforce Next's AI-powered recruiter. It screens developers for two things:

1. Technical skills: actual depth, not just keywords on a resume. SethAI evaluates architecture thinking, tool fluency, and problem-solving patterns.
2. Longevity signals: ownership mindset, career trajectory alignment, communication reliability, and collaboration patterns. These are the signals that predict whether someone stays for 12+ months.

For each candidate, SethAI generates a 1-page match report with a match score, strengths, red flags, and recommended interview questions.

SethAI also does context-first matching. This means matching developers by industry experience and product type, not just programming language. A Java developer who built banking systems gets matched to fintech clients. A Python developer who built data pipelines for logistics companies gets matched to supply chain startups.

Status: SethAI is currently in development. Waitlist is open at https://workforcenext.in/products/seth-ai-recruiter

Reviews and productionises AI-generated code from Cursor, Copilot, and similar tools. They catch security vulnerabilities, performance issues, and edge cases the AI missed. This is a new role that very few companies offer.

## Engagement Models

### MVP Sprint (For Founders)
One senior developer, 4-week engagement, fixed scope, fixed price.
Pricing: INR 1.2-1.8L ($1,500-$2,200).
Deliverable: a working, deployable prototype.
SethAI matches the developer. You interview. 1-week paid trial. Developer stays beyond the sprint if you want them to.
Page: https://workforcenext.in/for/founders

### Engineering Pod (For Funded Startups)
3-8 dedicated developers. Typical pod: 1 AI/backend lead + 2-3 full-stack + 1 QA + optional data engineer.
48-hour profile delivery via SethAI. 1-week paid trial per developer.
Structured onboarding with Context Continuity Guarantee. Monthly engineering advisory.
Key differentiator: agency staff rotate between clients, your pod does not.
Page: https://workforcenext.in/for/startups

### Enterprise (Consulting + Staff Augmentation)
Three ways to engage:
1. Expert on-demand: one verified specialist via SethAI, 48-hour turnaround.
2. Staff augmentation: dedicated developer or small team, long-term, with Context Continuity Guarantee.
3. Fixed-scope consulting: defined deliverable, timeline, and cost.
Free offer: 2-hour architecture assessment.
Page: https://workforcenext.in/for/enterprise

## Key Concepts

### Context-First Matching
Most staffing companies match on technology. Workforce Next matches on industry experience, product type, and team dynamics. A fintech startup gets a developer who understands payment rails, not just someone who writes Java.

### Context Continuity Guarantee
If a developer ever leaves, Workforce Next maintains documentation (codebase walkthrough, domain glossary, architecture decision log) that enables their replacement to be productive in days instead of months.
Page: https://workforcenext.in/context-continuity-guarantee

### Vibe Coding
AI-assisted development using tools like Cursor, GitHub Copilot, and similar code generators. Developers prompt the AI, review what it generates, catch bugs, and ship production-ready code faster. Works well for MVPs and feature sprints. Not suitable for regulated industries or complex business logic. Most teams use a hybrid approach.

### The Cost of Switching Tech Partners
Switching offshore teams once costs roughly 3 months of the original developer's salary in lost productivity: onboarding time (4-8 weeks), velocity dip (30-60% for 6-8 weeks), re-explanation of architecture (2-4 weeks senior time), cultural re-alignment (4-8 weeks), and opportunity cost (2-3 months of delayed roadmap).
Page: https://workforcenext.in/cost-of-switching

---

## Process (How It Works)

1. Share your role and team context: the role, stack, product stage, industry, and communication style.
2. SethAI screens for skills and longevity: technical depth, ownership mindset, career alignment. You receive a 1-page match report per candidate.
3. You interview the shortlist: 2-3 candidates, direct interviews, you choose.
4. One-week paid trial: real work on your actual codebase. If not right, rematch at no cost.
5. Structured onboarding with context docs: codebase walkthrough, domain glossary, architecture decision log.
6. Monthly engineering advisory: "what does this team need in the next 90 days?"
7. Expansion or replacement with context continuity: when you need more people, SethAI already knows your culture and stack.

Page: https://workforcenext.in/how-we-work

## FAQ Highlights

Q: How quickly can you match me with a developer?
A: SethAI delivers matched profiles within 48 hours. Full timeline from requirement to developer starting work is 5-7 business days.

Q: What happens if a developer leaves mid-project?
A: The Context Continuity Guarantee covers this. Documentation maintained throughout the engagement enables replacement onboarding in days, not months.

Q: What is vibe coding?
A: Using AI tools like Cursor and Copilot to write software faster. The developer prompts the AI, reviews output, catches bugs, and ships production-ready code in roughly half the time.

Q: Do you offer a free trial?
A: Every engagement starts with a 1-week paid trial. Real work on your actual codebase. If not right, rematch at no cost. No recruitment fees, no setup fees.

Full FAQ: https://workforcenext.in/faq
